name: solana_mcp
summary: Solana on-chain connector — Token-2022 mints with embedded on-chain SVG metadata that can be RE-WRITTEN via a single Metaplex token-metadata update tx (the 'mutating meme-coin' pattern). Stdlib-only (subprocess + json + base64) shelling out to the `solana`, `spl-token`, and `metaplex` CLI binaries on PATH. Keypair path + RPC URL + network resolved directly from .env via studio/auth/keys.load_env — `KINDS` in keys.py is NOT widened (this is a one-off connector, deliberately scoped narrow; SOLANA_KEYPAIR_PATH lives in .env alongside SOLANA_RPC_URL and SOLANA_NETWORK). Every successful tool call appends one InferenceRecord with model='solana_token_2022', tier='monetization', scope=f'solana_<tool>'. update_token_svg overrides scope='svg_mutation' so the inference DAG walks every re-skin tx. Mainnet writes are hard-gated behind explicit confirm=true — devnet/testnet (default devnet) treat the playground as free-fire. Sensitive params (keypair, raw SVG bytes) are redacted before crystallization — only mint address, signature, amount, and svg_byte_len + sha256-16 are persisted.
engine_pattern: ThirdPartyConnector subclass mirroring sui_mcp.py shape. SERVICE='solana'. Each tool composes argv for one of three CLIs (`solana`, `spl-token`, `metaplex`), dispatched via subprocess.run(capture_output=True, timeout=60s). Smoke-validates connection via `solana config get` (cheap + offline). Tool dispatch via send(recipient=tool_name, message=json_args). CLI stdout is parsed as JSON when possible; non-JSON spl-token/metaplex output is heuristically scraped for Signature:/Address:/Token: lines. mint_token_2022 is a four-step pipeline (create-token → create-account → mint → metaplex token-metadata create) — failure at any step short-circuits with a structured `_error` plus partial state.

env_vars.SOLANA_KEYPAIR_PATH: filesystem path to signing keypair JSON, e.g. ~/.config/solana/id.json (NEVER logged; falls back to default install path if file exists; connect() returns False if absent)
env_vars.SOLANA_MUTABLE_METADATA_PROGRAM: Metaplex Token Metadata program id (default metaqbxxUerdq28cj1RbAWkYQm3ybzjb6a8bt518x1s — the canonical mainnet program)
env_vars.SOLANA_TOKEN_2022_PROGRAM: override for the Token-2022 program id (default TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb — the canonical Token-2022 SPL program)

kinds_widening_note: studio/auth/keys.py defines KINDS = ('claude', 'pinterest', 'client', 'sui', 'stripe', 'tensorchain', 'deepseek'). 'solana' is NOT added — this connector reads SOLANA_KEYPAIR_PATH / SOLANA_RPC_URL / SOLANA_NETWORK directly from .env via load_env(). Rationale: salted-token registry is for human-rotatable secrets (API tokens) — a Solana signing keypair is a file path, not a salted token, and lives outside that registry. Documented here per build instruction. If later we need .upstream_key('solana') semantics, widen then.
convenience_wrappers: update_token_svg(mint, new_svg_string)   // THE mutating meme-coin tx
substrate: studio/third_party/solana/ (per-config persistence) + ~/.cc/third_party_logs/solana_sends.jsonl (history) + ~/.cc/inference_master_chain.jsonl (crystal-anchored monetization records, model='solana_token_2022'; scope='svg_mutation' for re-skin txs)

inbound_callers: studio passes pipeline: rendered SVG asset → final on-chain anchor via update_token_svg(...)
outbound_calls: inference_logger.log (every call: model='solana_token_2022', tier='monetization', scope='solana_<tool>' or 'svg_mutation' for update_token_svg)
routing_connections.substrate_reads: SOLANA_KEYPAIR_PATH / SOLANA_RPC_URL / SOLANA_NETWORK / SOLANA_MUTABLE_METADATA_PROGRAM / SOLANA_TOKEN_2022_PROGRAM via studio/auth/keys.load_env (mirrored .env between MySpace++ and gently)
routing_connections.substrate_writes: send_log entries + crystal_chain monetization records (keypair + raw SVG bytes redacted; svg_byte_len + sha256-16 persisted)

two_chain_bridge.shared_pattern: Both connectors implement a Token-2022-style on-chain metadata flow: an NFT/token whose 'art' (or arbitrary attribute payload) is stored on-chain and is updatable via a single tx. On Sui this is nft_mint with attrs_json under the TROLLN package; on Solana this is mint_token_2022 + update_token_svg with the SVG embedded in the Metaplex --uri.

differences.sui: Move package + custom nft module; attrs are structured JSON; updates via package-level entry functions; tier='monetization' or 'defi_loop' (lend_*).
differences.solana: Token-2022 SPL + Metaplex Token Metadata program; payload is a data: URI carrying the literal SVG bytes (base64-encoded); updates via the canonical Metaplex update tx; no DeFi loop in this connector (yet).
differences.settlement: Sui side handles transfer_usdc with --input-coins; Solana side handles transfer of any SPL/Token-2022 mint with --fund-recipient for first-time receivers.

shared_idioms: Mainnet write-gate via explicit confirm=true (Sui: 'mainnet'; Solana: 'mainnet-beta')
Stdlib-only (subprocess + json) — no chain-specific Python SDK
Crystal anchor on every send() — both surfaces feed into ~/.cc/inference_master_chain.jsonl with chain-specific model name
Graceful skip when CLI / keypair / wallet absent — never crashes the caller
two_chain_bridge.dual_chain_flow: A coin can be born on either chain, and its mutating art can be re-rendered by the same MySpace++ passes pipeline. The render-and-mutate step targets sui_mcp.nft_mint or solana_mcp.update_token_svg depending on which chain the asset's crystal record was anchored to. Both halves emit InferenceRecords into the same crystal chain — the DAG walker can traverse cross-chain provenance.

svg_mutation_pattern.what_it_is: A Token-2022 mint whose on-chain Metaplex metadata --uri is a `data:image/svg+xml;base64,<…>` payload carrying the LITERAL SVG bytes. The coin's 'art' lives on-chain, not on IPFS or an HTTPS server. Re-skinning is a single metaplex token-metadata update tx — no off-chain server, no DNS, no pinning service required.
svg_mutation_pattern.why_it_matters: Decoupling art from storage providers gives the coin a stable identity across any future chain reorg of the metadata service. The art mutates deterministically — every re-skin is a tx signature, every signature is a crystal anchor in the InferenceRecord chain — so the FULL VISUAL HISTORY of the coin is provable, walkable, and cryptographically signed.
how_to_mint: 1. Caller invokes mint_token_2022(name, symbol, decimals, initial_supply, svg_string).
3. spl-token create-token --program-id <Token-2022> creates the mint; create-account creates the holder ATA; mint deposits the initial supply.
4. metaplex token-metadata create writes the initial --uri pointing at the inline SVG. Returns mint + tx signatures.
how_to_mutate: 3. metaplex token-metadata update --mint <mint> --uri <new-data-uri> overwrites the on-chain metadata in one tx.

4. InferenceRecord anchors the mutation with scope='svg_mutation', model='solana_token_2022'; svg_byte_len + sha256-16 persisted so the visual history is walkable without exposing the raw SVG payload.
svg_mutation_pattern.redaction_promise: The raw SVG bytes are NEVER persisted in the crystal chain (they can be arbitrarily large and may carry user-attributable content). What IS persisted: the SVG byte length, the first 16 hex chars of its sha256, the mint address, and the resulting tx signature. The on-chain SVG itself is the system of record — the crystal chain stores the provenance trail.

guarantees: Crystal-anchored — every successful tool call has a deterministic InferenceRecord with model='solana_token_2022', tier='monetization', scope='solana_<tool>' (or 'svg_mutation' for update_token_svg)
Stdlib-only — no `solana-py` / `solders` / `metaplex` Python package required; subprocess + json + base64
Mainnet-gated writes — when SOLANA_NETWORK='mainnet-beta', mint_token_2022 / update_token_svg / transfer require explicit confirm=true; devnet/testnet are free-fire
Graceful CLI failures — if `solana` is not on PATH OR SOLANA_KEYPAIR_PATH unset, connect() returns False and send() emits SendResult(success=False, error='solana_cli_not_configured')
Keypair privacy — SOLANA_KEYPAIR_PATH value is never printed by the CLI surface; only path existence / length reported
SVG-payload privacy — raw SVG bytes for both mint_token_2022 and update_token_svg are stripped before crystallization; only byte length + sha256-16 persisted
Multi-step mint atomicity-of-error — mint_token_2022's 4-step pipeline short-circuits on any step failure and returns the partial state (mint, account, signatures) so the caller can resume
Bridge-aware — complements sui_mcp.py via the two_chain_bridge contract; same project, different settlement layer
usage_example:
from core.lib.third_party.solana_mcp import SolanaMCPConnector
c = SolanaMCPConnector()
c.connect()
# initial mint with inline SVG art
r = c.send('mint_token_2022', json.dumps({'name':'GENTLY','symbol':'GENT','decimals':6,'initial_supply':1000000,'svg_string':'<svg .../>'}))
mint = r.metadata['mint']
# THE mutating moment — rewrite the on-chain art
r2 = c.send('update_token_svg', json.dumps({'mint':mint,'new_svg_string':'<svg ...new art.../>'}))
print(r2.metadata['signature'], r2.crystal_id)  # scope='svg_mutation'
